about: FR-11 weighted-estimation and selection references, generated by scripts/parity/gen_r_weighted.R - do not edit by hand. Floats are %.17g decimal strings of IEEE-754 doubles; null = not recorded.

definitions.scheme: unit: unweighted; gen: w = w_gen/2^20; w01: the {0,1} weights; subset: unweighted on the points with w01 = 1
definitions.kendall: fasttau(u, v, weights) (VineCopula:::fasttau, BiCopEst's emptau): TauMatrix with weights, the C ktau without; TauMatrix(cbind(u, v), weights)[2, 1]
definitions.fit: BiCopEst(u, v, family = code, method, weights) (weights = NA unweighted)
definitions.pars: reference-agnostic key (README): [rho], [rho, nu], [theta] of the unrotated family (theta > 0; VineCopula's 90/270 codes take -theta), [theta, delta]
definitions.emptau: the fitted object's emptau (the weighted Kendall tau of the data)
definitions.loglik_weighted_own: sum(w * log(BiCopPDF(u, v, code, par, par2))) (w = 1 unweighted)
definitions.selection: BiCopSelect(u, v, familyset, selectioncrit, weights, rotations = FALSE, presel = FALSE, method = 'mle'); weighting unit: weights = NA; formula: w_i = ((7919 i) mod 1024 + 1)/1024 for the point of u-rank i; fits: each candidate's BiCopEst(method = 'mle', weights) and sum(log(BiCopPDF) * w), npars as BiCopSelect counts them; AIC = -2 loglik + 2 npars, BIC = -2 loglik + log(n) npars, n = length(u)
